label: thm:finite-stencil-direct
scope: Scalar algebra for truncation, joint row-direction-cover rearrangement, and the explicit normal-to-direct bound.
excluded: Fundamental-theorem integration and PLDR derivative evaluation.

label: prop:registered-capacity
excluded: Checkpoint parameter enumeration and numerical rank.

label: thm:stencil-normal-chart
scope: Finite-dimensional lower-edge and energy-equivalence algebra once chart constants are supplied.

label: thm:selected-edge-frame
scope: Pairwise softmax algebra, monotonicity under selected lower weights, and the positive-weight common-kernel identity.
excluded: Vocabulary-scale Jacobian construction and singular-value computation.

label: thm:conditional-balance
scope: Signed relative-curvature charge, exact zero balance, scalar force product, and Fisher-plus-second-jet split.
excluded: Conditional expectation theory and checkpoint HVP evaluation.

label: thm:full-adamw-successor
scope: The exact scalar three-block expansion with first and second moments and state-independent forcing.
excluded: Automatic differentiation, clipping-mask extraction, and chart retraction.

label: thm:backward-path-metric
scope: Scalar backward-metric dissipation, robust triangle gain, and conversion from scheduled to physical norm.
excluded: Positive-definite matrix eigensolvers and measured conditioning.

label: thm:variable-radius
scope: Time-dependent tube invariance and reduction of the quadratic term to its local effective gain.
excluded: Numerical radius construction and force measurement.

label: thm:master-collapse
scope: Substitution of a transverse envelope into the direct bound, exact zero terms, and the stationary forced radius.
excluded: PLDR chart, loss, optimizer, and path-metric premise construction.

label: thm:oriented-application
scope: Vector-center enclosure and its comparison with the stagewise triangle sum.
excluded: PLGA path capture and construction of the cell centers and radii.

label: cor:sharp-greedy-margin
scope: The square-root-two paired logit budget preserves each strictly qualified reference winner.
excluded: Extraction of centered logits and model decisions.
